So coverage grows by one underwriting year (2011 in 2021, 2011 and 2012 in 2022) and the last step (29,592 to 29,583) mixes UY2012's step to ten years (2022) with UY2011's step 9 to 10 years (2021), not the report year's movement of a fixed block.
